summary: Iteration 23 — AI Data Analyst (Reports) module end-to-end testing. 20/20 backend pytest cases passed (100%) covering examples, analyze happy paths (4 Azerbaijani prompts), validation (empty / 2000+ char), save-to-list happy path + persistence verification via /api/contact-lists/{id}/contacts, save validation (empty title / empty rows), RBAC (Mühasib → 403), and regression on key modules. Frontend Playwright E2E passed: prompt + analyze button + 13 example chips render, 'Hansı sektordan neçə şirkət var' returned 5 rows with correct headers (Sektor / Şirkət sayı), Excel export + Save to list buttons visible, save modal opens with pre-filled title and 6 mapping Selects, submit returns '5 kontakt əlavə edildi' toast, Ctrl+Enter shortcut triggers analysis, and regression pages (/attendance, /barter, /sales/contact-lists, /sales/invitations, /projects) all load without errors.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 3503 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline; should be split into feature modules (ai_analyst, hr, sales, finance, etc.) for maintainability. Not blocking, but accumulating tech debt across iterations.

AI pipeline security is correctly implemented: AI_FORBIDDEN_OPERATORS set ({$out, $merge, $function, $where, $accumulator, $redact}), recursive _scan_forbidden_operators traversal, AI_ALLOWED_COLLECTIONS allowlist including $lookup from-collection validation, pipeline length cap at 20 stages, _id stripped from results. Good defense-in-depth.
AI provider + model are env-configurable (AI_ANALYST_PROVIDER, AI_ANALYST_MODEL) with safe defaults — easy to swap back to GPT-5.2 when gateway stabilises.
In /api/ai/save-to-list, full_name is split only once on first space (['Ali', 'Mammadov Jr.']) — acceptable default. Minor edge case: names with only surname won't populate 'surname'.

Frontend Reports.jsx correctly uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, data-testid attributes are thorough for all interactive elements, 120s timeout matches slow AI latency, Ctrl+Enter handler works, and XLSX export uses safe filename regex.
